title: Rufus Shares an Apple
markdown:
Rufus the rabbit lived in a bright meadow full of buttercups. His long ears wiggled when he was very happy. And today, Rufus was very, very happy! Beside him was Pansy the pony, with a mane like soft moonlight.

They were filling a little basket with shiny red apples. The apples were red like tiny suns! "Ooh, perfect!" squeaked Rufus, sniffing one. Pansy snorted softly. Soon, the basket was full.

"Let's go to the gate, Pansy!" chirped Rufus. Pansy made a happy sound like a little bell and walked. Thump-thump went her hooves on the grass. The sun tickled her back.

"Oh, it's lovely, Pansy!" said Rufus. "The daisies look like they have happy faces!" he giggled. Busy bees hummed. The golden sun made everything feel special. The basket swung gently, smelling of sweet apples and warm sun.

Soon, they reached the meadow gate. Standing there was a donkey with ears as long as two big spoons. When he saw Rufus and Pansy, his long ears wiggled.

"Hello!" called Pansy. Rufus waved a paw. The donkey smiled a gentle smile. "Hello," he said, his voice warm. "You have beautiful apples."

Rufus hopped out. "They're the best from our meadow!" he said. "Would you like one?"

The donkey's big eyes grew wide. "Oh, if you please," he said. "Just one would be wonderful."

Rufus carefully picked the reddest, shiniest apple, like a little sun in his paws. He offered it to the donkey. The donkey took it very gently. Munch, munch, munch went the apple. A happy smile spread on the donkey's face. "Oh, that is the yummiest, sweet apple I have ever tasted," he said. "Thank you for sharing."

Rufus wiggled his nose. "You're welcome!" he squeaked. Pansy nudged the donkey softly. "It's nice to share things that make us happy," she whispered. The donkey nodded. "It truly is," he agreed.

The warm sun shone like a gentle hug. Rufus, Pansy, and the donkey stood together, feeling warm and happy. They shared the sweet apple and the happy feeling of being kind. The meadow, in the golden light, felt like the happiest place of all.
characters: Rufus the rabbit, Pansy the pony
